question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To smell a rat

options.text: To catch someone during a crime

solution:
The correct answer is: **To suspect something**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom "**To smell a rat**" means begin to suspect or realize that something is wrong in a particular situation. (संदेह करना या महसूस करना शुरू करें कि किसी विशेष स्थिति में कुछ गलत है)

 
 
• Example -* **When ​he died, investigators were called in and soon smelt a rat__.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**To smell a rat**" is "**To suspect something**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
